summary.value: Symptoms include bud blight, shepherd's crooking, stunting, wilting, delayed maturity, bud and leaf proliferation, reduced pod number, and discolored, distorted, and dead leaves. TSV infection can also cause discoloration and dead streaks at nodes, dark spots on pods, and delayed seed development.
summary.quote: Many symptoms of Tobacco ringspot virus (TRSV) (above) and Tobacco streak virus (TSV) (right) infection are similar. These symptoms include bud blight, shepherd's crooking, stunting, wilting, delayed maturity, bud and leaf proliferation, reduced pod number, and discolored, distorted, and dead leaves. TSV infection can cause discoloration and dead streaks at nodes, dark spots on pods, and delayed seed development.

diagnostic_features.value: TSV-specific symptoms include dark spots on pods and dead streaks at nodes; TRSV-infected plants may have discolored pith, petiole distortion and discoloration, leaf vein discoloration, and poor root nodulation, and shepherd's crooking can be a prominent symptom of tobacco ringspot.
diagnostic_features.quote: TSV infection can cause discoloration and dead streaks at nodes, dark spots on pods, and delayed seed development. TRSV-infected plants may have discolored pith, petiole distortion and discoloration, leaf vein discoloration, and poor root nodulation. Shepherd's crooking can be a prominent symptom of tobacco ringspot.

look_alikes.quote: Confused with Bean pod mottle (p. 14), Anthracnose stem blight (p. 26), Nutrient deficiency, Herbicide injury, Insect and mite damage

affected_parts.quote: Pods affected by white mold generally contain seeds that are smaller, lighter, white, and cottony (above). Seeds may be replaced by sclerotia.

summary.value: Pods affected by white mold generally contain seeds that are smaller, lighter, white, and cottony. Seeds may be replaced by sclerotia, and it is unusual for an infected seed to look normal.
summary.quote: Pods affected by white mold generally contain seeds that are smaller, lighter, white, and cottony (above). Seeds may be replaced by sclerotia. It is unusual for an infected seed to look normal.

diagnostic_features.value: Seeds are smaller, lighter, white, and cottony; seeds may be replaced by sclerotia (survival structures). Soybean seed lots can be contaminated with sclerotia.
diagnostic_features.quote: Pods affected by white mold generally contain seeds that are smaller, lighter, white, and cottony (above). Seeds may be replaced by sclerotia. It is unusual for an infected seed to look normal. Soybean seed lots can be contaminated with sclerotia, the survival structures produced by S. sclerotiorum in infected plants
